summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of two new features: (1) Getting Started page at /dashboard/getting-started and (2) Outreach page at /dashboard/outreach. Both features work as expected with tab navigation, content rendering, and all interactive elements functioning correctly.
passed_tests: Dashboard tab navigation - clicking 'Prospect Finder' goes to /dashboard
Dashboard tab navigation - clicking 'Outreach' goes to /dashboard/outreach
Dashboard tab navigation - clicking 'Getting Started' goes to /dashboard/getting-started
Getting Started page renders with Quick Start section (4 steps visible)
Getting Started page renders with Tutorial Videos section (5 video cards with 'Coming soon' placeholders)
Getting Started page renders with Tips & FAQ section (FAQ questions visible)
Outreach page renders with 5 template cards (Initial Introduction, Affiliate Programme Pitch, Product Review Request, Friendly Follow-Up, Video Collaboration)
Clicking a template card opens the template editor with variable inputs and email preview
Template variables can be filled in and preview updates in real-time (verified CHANNEL_NAME, YOUR_PRODUCT, TOPIC)
Copy Subject button is visible and clickable
Copy Body button is visible and clickable
Copy Full Email button is visible and clickable
'All Templates' button returns to template gallery
Bug report button works on Dashboard (/dashboard)
Bug report button works on Outreach page (/dashboard/outreach)
Bug report button works on Getting Started page (/dashboard/getting-started)
Logout button works from Outreach page - redirects to landing
All existing pages still load: Landing (/), Login (/login), Signup (/signup), Pricing (/pricing), Terms (/terms), Privacy (/privacy), Forgot Password (/forgot-password)
/dashboard still shows the Prospect Finder tool with search config (keywords input, filters, search button)
Protected routes work - unauthenticated users redirected from /dashboard/outreach to /login
critical_code_review_comments: Clipboard copy functions use navigator.clipboard.writeText - will show permission error in test environments but works in production browsers
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 tested two new dashboard features: (1) Getting Started page - has Quick Start (4 steps), Tutorial Videos (5 cards with 'Coming soon' placeholders), and Tips & FAQ sections. (2) Outreach page - has 5 email template cards. Clicking a template opens editor with variable inputs on left and live email preview on right. Variables like {{CHANNEL_NAME}} get replaced in real-time. Copy buttons (Subject, Body, Full Email) use navigator.clipboard. All 3 dashboard tabs (Prospect Finder, Outreach, Getting Started) have consistent header with bug report and logout buttons. Tab navigation uses data-testid: nav-tool, nav-outreach, nav-getting-started.
